title: Clamped Input Position
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $y$ be a Boolean list, and let $p$ be a natural number. The position is the index $\\min(p, |y|+1)$ in the range from $0$ to $|y|+1$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
